technical.summary: PCG shows mixed technicals with strong trend structure (above key EMAs, ADX trending, Ichimoku bullish) but momentum is deteriorating (bearish MACD cross, stochastic bearish cross, RSI not rising) and price is below Hull MA, suggesting caution on swing entry.

fundamental.summary: PCG shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 58 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for a bullish thesis.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (3-4 years old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (311.68) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures utilities with debt exposure, and earnings in 58 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price near support (12.167) with strong trend structure (above 200-EMA, ADX trending, Ichimoku bullish) and extreme fear sentiment (33/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Deteriorating momentum (bearish MACD/stochastic crosses, RSI not rising), zero fundamental support, severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), earnings event risk in 58 days, and price below Hull MA make this a high-risk, low-conviction setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Price at support with trend structure intact, but deteriorating momentum and zero fundamental conviction make this a low-probability swing setup. Extreme macro headwinds and earnings event risk in 58 days outweigh contrarian sentiment opportunity.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + earnings in 58 days create compounding event and macro risk; momentum deterioration (bearish MACD/stochastic crosses) suggests support may not hold.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding PCG with 52 open Utilities positions (28% of portfolio); sector concentration and existing position reduce conviction further—skip entry.
